verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers user-facing digital tools, including the LathamDrive document generator and the Book of Jargon apps, that handle user data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control or data-use commitment. The Privacy & Cyber page describes legal advisory services for clients, not a product control over the user's own data, so it earns no credit.
